The indication carries no atherosclerotic-disease restriction, no prior-event requirement and no LDL-C threshold, so the enrolled populations of both trials on this unit are already inside it: NCT05360446 enrols non-obstructive coronary artery disease without previous cardiovascular events on maximally tolerated statin therapy, and NCT05739383 (14,012 participants) enrols high-risk primary prevention.
